items.name: b11647
items.body:
<details open>

vulkan : copy strided f16 KV once on AMD so reads spread across memory channels (#27703)

* vulkan : copy strided f16 KV once so reads spread across memory channels

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 4.8 / Opus 5)

* tests : cover the f16 KV copy to scratch

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 4.8 / Opus 5)

* vulkan : gate the f16 KV scratch copy to AMD

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 4.8 / Opus 5)

* vulkan : reuse the generic copy shader for the f16 KV scratch fill

The f16 clause needs only a strided copy, not a dequant, so drop the
dedicated shader and dispatch the existing copy pipeline instead. The
copy is described in source memory order so the strided access lands on
the writes, which stream, instead of the reads, which would concentrate
on a few memory channels.

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 4.8 / Opus 5 / Fable 5)

* vulkan : extend the strided KV scratch copy to bf16

Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5

* vulkan : clean up comments

Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5

* consolidate copy shaders

* disable on RDNA4

---------

Co-authored-by: Ruben Ortlam <rortlam@redhat.com>

</details>

items.name: b11643
items.body:
<details open>

graph: keep the graph non empty without embeddings (#30522)

An embedding-only graph has no logits, and build_pooling() returns
early when embeddings are off, so since the models no longer expand
t_embd the graph ends up empty and its inputs are never allocated.
Expand t_embd in that case.

</details>
